articles.headline: MRUCI re-elects Vikram Sakhuja and Dhruba Mukherjee as chairman and vice chairman
articles.summary: The Media Research Users Council India (MRUCI) has unanimously re-elected Madison Media's Vikram Sakhuja and ABP Network's Dhruba Mukherjee at its 30th AGM.

articles.headline: JetSynthesys and Japan's MIXI sign MOU to explore gaming collaboration in India
articles.summary: The two companies will explore game development, publishing, marketing, esports and digital entertainment in one of the world's most exciting gaming markets.

articles.headline: Bajaj Capital appoints Samir Dewan as group CEO to drive business integration
articles.summary: With over three decades of financial leadership, Samir Dewan will spearhead technology transformation and omnichannel wealth distribution for the conglomerate.

articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Broadcast networks plan heavy programming slate for festive Q3
articles.summary: Major national and regional broadcast conglomerates are investing over ₹1,200 crore into fiction and reality show formats to maximize festive linear ad spot inventory.

articles.headline: Sri Adhikari Brothers revives Suraag and Damini as it rebuilds TV slate
articles.summary: SAB Group is re-entering television production by developing modern adaptations of cult classic IPs for broadcast and digital streaming buyers.

articles.headline: Krishna Mishra joins ETGovernment as lead of community and government relations
articles.summary: Mishra brings extensive public policy and cross-ministerial outreach expertise to scale institutional dialogues and knowledge initiatives.

articles.headline: TRAI issues consultation paper on National Broadcasting Policy recommendations
articles.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India seeks industry stakeholder comments on copyright protections, audience measurement standards, and ease of doing business.

articles.headline: FilterCopy Comedy unveils 30 plus comedian line-up for Hahakaar in Mumbai
articles.summary: Pocket Aces' comedy banner announces a three-day live experiential comedy festival bringing together prominent sketch and stand-up creators.

articles.headline: DTH subscribers reach equilibrium as linear TV coexists with connected platforms
articles.summary: Hybrid set-top boxes providing linear channels alongside OTT streaming apps are stabilizing pay-TV churn across urban and suburban customer cohorts.

articles.headline: OTT platforms unveil collaborative anti-piracy framework with telecom operators
articles.summary: Leading digital streamers and internet service providers deploy dynamic domain blocking and watermark detection to safeguard direct-to-digital film releases.
